column1: # Commands of the extension package "games" (docs/PLAN-extensions.md). Same columns as scripts/lib/registry.tsv:
# Only rows under this package's own name (user: ext games ..., sys: sys ext games ...) are loaded, and only while the package is on.
# The script is a path under scripts/ or @/file inside this folder (the scripts of this package live here).

column5: game PCs saved for Sunshine streaming (name, MAC, address)
column6: gespeicherte Spiele-PCs für Sunshine (Name, MAC, Adresse)

column5: save a game PC: hs ext games add <name> <mac> [<ip>]
column6: einen Spiele-PC merken: hs ext games add <Name> <MAC> [<IP>]

column5: forget a saved game PC: hs ext games remove <name>
column6: einen gemerkten Spiele-PC vergessen: hs ext games remove <Name>

column5: switch a game PC on (Wake-on-LAN), --wait until its Sunshine answers: hs ext games wake <name> [--wait]
column6: einen Spiele-PC einschalten (Wake-on-LAN), mit --wait bis sein Sunshine antwortet: hs ext games wake <Name> [--wait]

column5: game PCs as name, mac, address (address - when none)
game PCs as name, address, state (up = Sunshine answers on port 47989, down, unknown = no address); a 1 s try each
what waking, saving or forgetting a game PC would do, as data: status, plan lines (never asks; exit 0 ok, 1 refused, 2 = the MAC is missing)
do it (hs sys ext games start <name> wake | add --mac <mac> [--ip <ip>] | remove), answers status done
